# Unipheas — Product development systems and practical AI

> Brian Phillips helps businesses establish the tools, AI workflows, engineering
> practices, and knowledge to develop, release, and maintain their own products.

Unipheas is Brian's independent consulting practice. Clients work directly with
him. He has more than 15 years across full-stack development, mobile development,
and software systems. Mobile is a specialty supporting the broader offer.

## Engagements

- Establish: connect product priorities, company knowledge, AI tools, code review,
  testing, and releases into a working development process.
- Improve: implement AI workflows, clarify handoffs, and reduce repeated work.
- Stabilize: understand existing systems, resolve ownership and process gaps,
  and establish how to diagnose problems and maintain the product.

The focus is building the client's ability to develop and operate products.
Implementation on real product work establishes and validates the process.
Deliverables are agreed for each engagement and can include configured tools,
documented workflows, release procedures, and owner or team training.
Scope, fees, and timing are agreed before paid work begins. Ongoing work is
scoped separately. An independent software audit is an optional starting point.

AI workflows use agreed access, checks, and human review. Engineering expertise
remains necessary. Company code, accounts, and documentation should stay under
client control. Examples on the site are illustrative, not client results.
